4.source: relic set 101 (Passerby of Wandering Cloud), 4-piece ability Ability51011: "At the start of the battle, immediately regenerates 1 Skill Point."
4.note: The description carries no placeholder, so the amount is the literal 1 it states. Modeled as BATTLE_START + GAIN_SKILL_POINT: the rules are the character trigger table's, so the set reuses the existing op instead of getting an execution channel of its own. Ordering: the opening skill points are assigned when the Battle is constructed (StandardSkillPointPolicy's start value), and BATTLE_START is fired later in Battle.startBattle(), so this rule is what turns the opening 3 into 4 -- see RelicAbilityBattleTest.openingSkillPointsIncludeThePasserbyFourPiece.
